query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT created_at, id FROM vf_accounts WHERE status = $1 AND ((created_at, id) < ($5, $4)) AND ($4 IS NOT NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id) >= $2) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3) UNION ALL (SELECT created_at, id FROM vf_accounts WHERE status = $1 AND ($4 IS NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id) >= $2) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $6 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN vf_account_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at desc, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
